Charged per call: 0.01 USDC on Base mainnet via x402 (scheme exact, asset 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, payTo 0x27EbD1DDCB6607bE8641784A1bf654623Fc8290e). An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with the machine-readable x402 challenge in the body.
